text: 802.3bt Type 4 PoE delivers how much power at the powered device?
explanation: Type 4 provides 90 W at the source and 71.3 W at the device after cable losses. The four steps are 802.3af (12.95 W at the device), 802.3at (25.5 W), 802.3bt Type 3 (51 W) and Type 4 (71.3 W). Budgeting a switch requires the source figure and the device count.
